column1: # Known deviations of the implementations under test, verified by hand.
# A failing result matching client, peer and scenario (fnmatch patterns) is
# reported as "known-difference" with the waiver id and the note; it still
# appears in every report. A waiver whose scenario ran and passed no longer
# reproduces, and fails the run: remove the line when the deviation is fixed.

column8: calimero-server 3.0-M1 stops answering for about 10 s after a 3-octet datagram: its log shows the control endpoint coming up again ("control endpoint ... is up and running"); cause: an uncaught KNXIllegalArgumentException ("negative length of message body") in UdpServiceLooper closes the control endpoint; fixed upstream after 3.0-M2 by calimero-server d276d8a8 (2026-09-14), not in a release or image yet
calimero-server 3.0-M1 stops answering for about 10 s after a CONNECT_REQUEST whose CRI has length 0, the same uncaught exception as after a truncated header; fixed upstream by d276d8a8

column4: Data Secure group write through a secure tunnel*
column8: calimero-tools 3.0-M1 send Data Secure group telegrams only through a surrogate device (S-A_Sync and group object diagnostics with the surrogate's tool key) and require every sender of the group in the keyring to be such a device; the profile's tunnel groups list the tunnel addresses as senders, and no surrogate is on the tunnel. Through secure routing, with a system under test as the surrogate (capability surrogate), it works (secure routing scenarios).

column4: Data Secure group write over secure routing*
column8: calimero-tools 3.0-M1 send Data Secure group telegrams only through a surrogate device; xknx does not act as one, and the pairing has no surrogate on the network. Towards a system under test with the surrogate capability, it passes.

the same cause as calimero-tools-data-secure-tunnel: calimero-tools 3.0-M1 send and read Data Secure groups only through a surrogate device with a tool key ("no device toolkey for 0.0.0"); knx-sim has none on its bus

column4: knx-sim: SESSION_STATUS close ends the session
column8: calimero-tools 3.0-M1 (calimero-core 3.0-M1) keeps its tunnel and TCP connection after the gateway's SESSION_STATUS close: 18 s later knx-sim still had the channel, and the tool logged nothing; the status is known to the code (statusMsg) but a close from the server is not acted on

column4: knx-sim: unacknowledged request reported as failed*
column8: xknx 4.1.1 repeats the TUNNELLING_REQUEST once and closes the tunnel ("Sending TunnellingRequest failed twice"), as the standard asks; CEMIHandler.send_telegram raises, but the TelegramQueue that sends queued telegrams only logs the CommunicationError, so the adapter's write (xknx.telegrams.put + join), like any application using the queue, cannot see that nothing was sent (xknx#2024, tracked in otfabric/knx-interop#24)

column4: knx-sim: unacknowledged request reported as failed*
column8: KNXUltimate 6.3.2's KNXClient.write returns void (fire and forget): the adapter, like any KNXUltimate application, cannot tell a write the gateway never acknowledged from one it did

column4: knx-sim router: ROUTING_BUSY holds back the answer*
column8: KNXUltimate 6.3.2 reports a received ROUTING_BUSY as an error event and keeps sending: it answered 5 ms after a ROUTING_BUSY with wait time 500 ms (KNXnet/IP routing flow control asks for a pause of at least the wait time)

column4: knx-sim router: ROUTING_BUSY holds back the answer*
column8: knxd 0.14.73 defines ROUTING_BUSY (src/libserver/eibnetip.h) but its router backend does not act on a received one: it answered 31 to 114 ms after a ROUTING_BUSY with wait time 500 ms

column4: Data Secure group write over secure routing*
column8: calimero-tools 3.0-M1 send Data Secure group telegrams only through a surrogate device; cB-Sigma knx does not act as one ("no device toolkey"), as with xknx (calimero-tools-data-secure-routing).
